name: Board Meeting / Executive Briefing
description: Capture key decisions, presentations, and governance items from board meetings, executive briefings, and leadership sessions.

sections.title: Meeting Overview
sections.instruction: Summarize the meeting type (board meeting, executive briefing, committee session, etc.), the organization, and the primary purpose or context of the session.

sections.title: Attendees & Quorum
sections.instruction: List board members, executives, guests, and advisors present. Note if quorum was established or any notable absences.

sections.title: Agenda Items
sections.instruction: List the agenda items covered in order, with a brief one-line description of each.

sections.title: Reports & Presentations
sections.instruction: Summarize each report or presentation given (e.g., CEO report, financial report, committee updates). Include key metrics, findings, or highlights shared.

sections.title: Motions & Votes
sections.instruction: Document all formal motions made, who moved and seconded them, the vote outcome, and whether the motion passed or failed.

sections.title: Key Decisions & Directives
sections.instruction: Summarize major decisions made, strategic directives issued, and any guidance the board or executives provided to leadership.

sections.title: Action Items & Follow-Up
sections.instruction: List all tasks assigned, follow-up items requested, and items deferred to a future meeting. Include owners and deadlines.

sections.title: Next Meeting
sections.instruction: Note the date, time, location, and any pre-announced agenda items for the next scheduled meeting.
